title: Alexa, Google, Siri: What are Your Pronouns? Gender and Anthropomorphism in the Design and Perception of Conversational Assistants
reasoning: The paper specifically investigates the ethical implications of gendered and anthropomorphic design choices in conversational AI assistants. It argues that these design choices can perpetuate negative gender stereotypes and lead to harmful real-world behaviors, making ethical evaluation a core component of the research rather than a minor consideration.
